reviews.x: I ordered this wig as part of my halloween costume and I was not disappointed! I was aiming for a sleeker hairstyle versus Cruella's frizzy, crazy hair. The style of this wig was cute with a bob-like cut and some subtle waves. It was super soft. I got many compliments throughout the night and some people thought it was my real hair (lol?????).  I definitely recommend this product!
It’s awesome! The part is a little weird, but a few adjustments and it’s awesome!
This wig wasn't frizzy or damaged. It came with a nice hair net. It also didn't have folds in it from the packaging

The wig seems a little limp and then right out of the bag, but I lightly teased it, and sprayed it with a little aqua net and was VERY pleased with the outcome. There is actually a lot of thickness there! This was the second wig I bought, the first one (it was a different style from a different company) was horrible. I highly recommend this model for your Cruella costume. Note, I didn't realize there was an elastic strap, and had to make a public wig adjustment. So just note that there is a stra
Cutest wig ever! It's not hot and really not itchy either. I highly suggest this and it looks pretty good to be so inexpensive!

reviews.t: The wig is great. Fun color
reviews.x: The wig is great. Fun color, soft hair, comfortable enough to wear all day.  Has a clip to make it tighter if needed.

I bought this wig for a Halloween costume. The price point worked for me since I was only going to wear this wig a few times. The wig is good to wear out of the bag, but I did some modifications to the wig cap, and cut a lot of hair. The wig is workable. There's a lot of hair to work with, so you can experiment with cutting/styling.  I wouldn't recommend wearing this wig for everyday use because it looks fake. However, it's great for costumes and the price is low.

This wig was exactly what I wanted for my costume. Pretty good quality. The only issue with the wig as far as comfort was it was a tad big and wouldn’t be adjusted so it kept slipping back only because I didn’t glue it so next time I think it’ll be fine . So happy about my look !

I wanted an authentic-looking costume wig at an inexpensive price.  This was PERFECT for a Schitt's Creek-themed party (I went as Moira Rose).  The color is as pictured.  The "hair" wasn't so bad, but there were definitely scraggly ends that needed to be trimmed.  I don't have experience with "real" wigs, but the fasteners seemed easy enough to figure out. I had such high hopes for this cute black & white wig.  I had planned on going as an updated cruella de ville for Halloween (& my little was going as a dalmatian). It looked horrible. Unwearable, in my opinion. It looked cheesy fake to me, but I likely got what I paid for. I was disappointed because other pictures seemed to show a cuter look to it. I returned it, sadly. Amd ended up not being able to dress up for Halloween. Maybe it'll work better for you.

So pretty! It looked better than this photo. Very thick and realistic hair. I bought a month prior to Halloween and had it laying around, i was worried it would get tangled but it didnt. I even brushed though and it looked even better- did not lose its waves. It bottom part is more full than the photo which is good. Loved it! Also came with a great cap. It wasn’t itchy

Omg yass! I love this wig I go to music festivals and it stayed put dancing all day and night , as well as me taking of my helmet. Comfortable and not cheap looking. So impressed I will definitely be buying more

I order this for my Halloween costume and it came very quickly, which I appreciate. It is a cheap wig so you get what you buy. However, the color of the wig is exactly how you see in the picture and very viberate. It is actually a very beautiful wig for the price that I paid. I definitely think it is worth the money. The only reason why I didn’t give it 5 stars was because the wig does a few stands that stick out like there was breakage. But like I said before, you get what you paid for. I would

This is definitely shorter than I thought it would be, but just by a little and I have really long hair so maybe I’m just a little crazy.. but it’s not hot to wear and is really cute! It’s definitely wig looking so if you want something more realistic this is probably not the wig for you. Overall I’m pretty happy as I got this to wear as Cruella Deville!  (Also in the picture, I have it pinned back a little bit because I hate having hair in my face and this wig does fall into the face a bit)

reviews.t: Great looking wig, however not the most comfortable wig I have ever worn.
reviews.x: The front part of this wig, like the part that frames the face is too close together I had to pull back some hair so that my face could be seen. It’s also quite itchy so a good wig cap might be a good idea, however for the value this wig is great, it’s not a cheap, frizzy wig like from a costume store. The curls are bouncy and it moves like regular hair. I got a TON of compliments about how pretty it was.

This wig is so good for how inexpensive it is! I ordered it for a “sexy alien” cosplay but I wear it out sometimes just for fun. It’s actually decent quality and the color is vibrant and nice. The part is a little weird, but other than that it’s fine. I want one in every color!

reviews.t: it’s a good quality wig and it fit and it’s soft
reviews.x: The ombré isn’t noticable at all, especially not in pictures. The wig was also shorter than I anticipated. Otherwise, it’s a good quality wig and it fit and it’s soft. It’s hard to find a good quality green wig so I am happy with this purchase.

[[VIDEOID:6ccddebd24f1f024b627c4d7a90aab6c]] Y'all have no idea how much I love this wig. I've used it for Mardi gras, bachelorette parties, st Patrick's day, Halloween. I've definitely got my money's worth.
This was not cute.. it was nappy, cheap, and way shorter than I expected — bob length, not at all shoulders.. I’m 5’5’ and don’t have a giraffe neck so I’m not sure what was up with it. ~ Returned ~
excellent quality for the price. Actuall color of wig was slightly lighter then what is pictured but not enough to make a difference. Would buy from this seller again

This product was not at all like the picture. terrible wayyyy to expensive
This wig is exactly what I wanted and it looked amazing on 💚
I love it! Doesn't feel cheap and I can put heat to it.

Many reviewers describe the hair as soft, thick, and not frizzy, with some noting it looks better than expected.
Several reviewers mention the wig is comfortable to wear, though a few note itchiness or fit issues.
Some reviewers note the wig requires adjustments or trimming, and a few found it looked fake or unwearable.
Reviewers commonly report receiving compliments and find the wig suitable for Halloween and costume use.
